talking_points.headline: DBS embeds agentic AI bank-wide under Tan Su Shan, raising the APAC AI-transformation bar
talking_points.context_html: Tan Su Shan, Group CEO of DBS is pushing generative and agentic AI into every corner of the bank's internal operations, not just client-facing tools, according to an exclusive Forbes Asia profile out this week. DBS is HSBC's sharpest APAC wealth and digital rival, and its shift from AI pilots to embedded, bank-wide agentic workflows sets a delivery pace that HSBC WPB's own AI-enabled change programme needs to match or beat.
source_links: DBS's Tan Su Shan leads bank into an AI future

talking_points.headline: Standard Chartered pushes wealth management into India's GIFT City
talking_points.context_html: Standard Chartered secured in-principle IFSCA approval to distribute wealth products from GIFT City and aims to launch within months, extending its India wealth footprint through a new offshore-onshore distribution channel. For Adam, it's a live example of a competitor opening a lower-friction cross-border wealth distribution route just as HSBC weighs its own India and cross-border wealth priorities.
source_links: StanChart expands GIFT City wealth push

talking_points.headline: Singapore's DBS, OCBC and UOB all post record wealth fees as loan margins narrow
talking_points.context_html: DBS, OCBC and UOB each notched record wealth management income, fees and AUM in their latest results, with all three leaning harder on wealth fees as loan margins narrow. For Adam, it's a reminder that the competitive pressure on HSBC's Singapore wealth franchise isn't just from DBS — OCBC and UOB are scaling wealth as a core profit engine too, at a moment when wealth fee income is exactly the lever HSBC WPB is also pulling.
source_links: Singapore's big three notch record wealth AUM

Competitor Intelligence.title: An Exclusive Look Into How DBS Group CEO Tan Su Shan Is Leading Singapore's Banking Giant Into An AI Future
Competitor Intelligence.summary: Forbes Asia profile details how DBS is embedding generative and agentic AI across every part of its internal operations, not just customer-facing tools, under Group CEO Tan Su Shan. The bank raised its full-year 2026 income guidance after a record Q2, with Tan positioning AI-enabled workflow redesign as core to that growth.

Competitor Intelligence.title: Standard Chartered expands GIFT City presence with wealth management push
Competitor Intelligence.summary: Standard Chartered received in-principle IFSCA approval to distribute capital market products from India's GIFT City, and plans to launch a wealth management proposition there within months, starting with its Signature CIO Funds. The move extends the bank's India wealth footprint even as it works through senior departures in that business.

Private Banking & Wealth.title: Singapore's big three notch record wealth income, fees and AUM
Private Banking & Wealth.summary: DBS, OCBC and UOB all reported record wealth management income, fees and AUM in their latest results, as Singapore's largest lenders lean harder on wealth fees to offset narrowing loan margins. DBS remains the largest by AUM, but OCBC and UOB both posted double-digit net-new-money growth.
